records.statement: Pass identity and options: def AutoVectorizeV2 : Pass<"hfusion-auto-vectorize-v2", "ModuleOp">, summary 'Tile, fuse and vectorize all linalg named ops', constructor mlir::hfusion::createHFusionAutoVectorizeV2Pass(); options vectorLength (unsigned, default 256, 'Length of the vector in bytes'), maxFusedOps (unsigned, default 15, 'Maximum number of ops allowed in one fused node'), enableVFStackLimit (bool, false), enableMultipleConsumerFusion (bool, true), emitTransformSequence (bool, false, 'Emit AutoVectorizeV2 payload tags and transform sequence without applying it'), treeReduce (bool, false), enableCrossIfFusion (bool, false).

Module entry flow (runOnOperation): collectFusableFuncInModule gathers device funcs, skipping funcs with FusionKind ShallowCV/SingleCube ('Skip this for now'); private callees whose name contains '_fused_' and that return a static tensor with more than kLargeTensorMinElements=4096 elements are inlined into their SIMD caller ('so ... large enough to overflow UB if left as cross-VF intermediate buffers', TODO remove after better solution); each remaining fusable func goes through runAttempt; a failed attempt emits warning 'AutoVectorizeV2 failed;' and calls signalPassFailure; at the end the pass removes the VFFusion cost-selection attrs kTreeReductionSelectionFrozenAttr/kRegularTreeReductionScopeAttr and per-op kRegisterTreeReductionSelectedAttr/kRegularTreeReductionSelectedAttr ('internal communication between VFFusion and AutoVectorizeV2. Do not leak them into the lowered module').

Clone-attempt discipline: runAttempt clones the whole func as 'cloned_<name>' and vectorizes the clone; on success the original func is erased, the clone is renamed back to the original name, and sortFunc topologically re-sorts blocks; on failure the clone is erased and failure is returned, leaving the original function untouched.

Per-function execution: vectorize() builds the transform::SequenceOp, executes it via transform::applyTransformNamedSequence, erases the sequence, then on success runs refineStaticLoopCarriedTensorTypes (a narrowly guarded rewrite that restores static shapes on softmax tree-reduce accumulators tensor<1xNx32xf32> with N in {16,8,4,2} inside a 19x32 f32 row loop, tag __hfusion_av2_refined_loop_carried_tensor_shape), and finally hfusion::AutoVectorizeVerifier.verifyFreeVectorRegion(true).check(func) must succeed. With emitTransformSequence=true the pass instead tags the payload func auto_vectorize_v2.payload.<name> and the sequence auto_vectorize_v2.transform.<name> and returns early without applying ('for debugging/replay only'); the separate hfusion-auto-vectorize-interpreter pass applies such tagged sequences later.

Plan construction per block (blocks whose parent is func::FuncOp/scf::ForOp/scf::IfOp/scf::WhileOp/scope::ScopeOp, skipping blocks inside cube scopes): planFuseSiblingForLeafNodes groups 'fusable output nodes' (isFusableOutputNode: fusable op whose users are all NonVectorizableOp, terminators, ops of other blocks, bufferization-dialect ops, with annotation::MarkOp and hfusion::AssertOp users ignored) into FusedNodes; planFuseProducersIntoConsumers BFS-walks operands upward, fusing a producer only once all its fusable users are handled; ctx.computeTileSize() then estimates tile sizes; finally tileAndFuseSiblingForLeafNodes and fuseProducersIntoConsumers emit the transform ops.

Emitted transform sequence: per fused node, transform::TileUsingForOp per leaf (or tileReductionOp / tileReductionOpRegisterTree / tileReductionOpTreeReduce for the three reduction paths), then transform::LoopFuseSiblingOp + LoopFuseNestedSiblingsOp chains the tiled loops, annotates the fused loop with the node label (and 'outlinedLoopWithFill' when a fill op is in the node); producers are fused with transform::MergeProducerExtractUsesOp + FuseIntoContainingOp into the containing loop and tiled there, followed by ApplyRegisteredPassOp 'eliminate-single-iteration-scf-for'; buildVectorizeTransformSequence emits transform::VectorizeOp for every labeled linalg::LinalgOp and for the auxiliary 'otherVectorizableOps' (fill/split/combining ops created by reduction tiling), while interleave/deinterleave are deliberately left to convert-hfusion-to-hivmave; applyCleanUp interleaves LICM, canonicalization, merge-consecutive-insert-extract-slice and CSE (SimplifyTrivialLoops disabled).

Label attributes are the plan-to-IR bridge: PlanContext::initFusableOpInfoFrom names every fusable op with a unique attr 'hfusion-auto-vectorize-target-<n>' (fusableOpCount starting at 1); each FusedNode gets loop label 'outlined-loop-target-<n>' from PlanContext::nextLoopLabel; getOpTransformHandle matches ops back by label attr via transform::MatchOp inside the sequence.

Op classification: isFusableOp accepts linalg::LinalgOp plus hfusion::InterleaveOp/DeinterleaveOp that are not NonVectorizableOp (and ops fusable into vsstb transposes); isNonVectorizableOp covers SIMT ops, scalar-predicate arith.select, matmul-family ops, single-element linalg (except Generic/Map), hfusion Load/Store/indirect/collective ops, tensor shape/extract/slice/reshape/collapse/expand/concat ops, hivm Copy/Custom/Debug/Store/Bitcast/VGather/VSort and all sync-block ops, scf::ForOp/WhileOp/IfOp, scope::ScopeOp, func::CallOp, memref::CopyOp, and bufferization::MaterializeInDestinationOp.

Group acceptance (FusedNode::canAccept with per-call-site flag subsets Sibling/Producer/FallbackLeaf, intentionally not unified per the header TODO): reject when node size >= maxFusedOps (default 15); reject memref-DPS groups unless Producer context (checkIsMemref); require VF stack-slot budget via VFStackInfoBuilder::fitsStack ('Keep AutoVectorize planning aligned with the VF stack-slot budget'); reject rank-reducing candidates in vsstb nodes and vice versa; require a common axis (equal shape, or equal dim-0 for rank>1); reject when the candidate conflicts with any member. A stack-limit workaround (cannotOpenStackLimitWorkaround) disables the limit for one specific large pure-linalg shape because 'conflicts are still collected per-op rather than per-node' and the scattered layout defeats the conflict analysis.

Conflict model (PlanContext): opConflicts pair every upstream×downstream fusable op across a pivot op; syncConflicts pair previous×following fusable ops around scf::ForOp/WhileOp/IfOp, scope::ScopeOp and hivm sync-block ops (cross-region handling extended when enableCrossIfFusion, with hivm::AnchorOp interrupting); copyConflicts come from memref/hivm CopyOp source/target operand sharing and from a targeted GM RAW scan pairing nearest fusable producers of a bufferization::MaterializeInDestinationOp with nearest fusable consumers of an overlapping memref::LoadOp ('A GM RAW dependence is not represented in the tensor SSA graph'; static rank-1 view overlap, unknown ranges treated as possible alias); dissolvePivot discharges op/group conflicts once the pivot joins a fused node, reporting fatal errors on inconsistent state.

Tree-reduction policy: canShareTreeReductionSiblingLoop keeps at most one split-reduction tree per fused node ('Downstream lowering is not correctness-safe when two distinct split-reduction trees share one containing loop') and keeps register-tree loops dedicated ('The direct register lowering replaces its containing loop. Keep that loop dedicated to the reduction'); the same invariant is re-applied when a reduction is accepted as a producer; three tiling paths exist — tileReductionOp (parallel axes via TileUsingForOp, reduction axis via TileReductionUsingForOp, fill/split/combining aux ops annotated into otherVectorizableOps, dynamic combining op generalized), tileReductionOpRegisterTree (only annotates the loop with kRegisterTreeReductionLoopAttr for the post-vectorization TreeReduceV2 rewrite), and tileReductionOpTreeReduce (pads to power-of-two with the neutral element 'instead of reducing a power-of-two prefix and merging an unbalanced tail', global pairwise tree for reductions <= 64, bounded radix-16 split hierarchy above).

Tile-size policy: last-axis vectorization with tileSize[last] = vectorLength / maxElemByteWidthOfNode (default 256 bytes; i64 counted as 32 bits by registerAndAnalyzeOp); only vsstb-transpose nodes get multi-axis vectorization, splitting the byte budget over the two innermost axes; vsstb transposes get their tile sizes permuted with a tileInterchange; dynamic extents are recorded as kDynamic with a FIXME that unrelated dynamic domains may then group together and a failed fusion 'may roll back the entire AutoVectorizeV2 attempt' (issue 378).

Producer-fusion legality: findBestFusedNodeForProducer refuses vsstb-pattern transpose producers, refuses multi-consumer fusion for non-linalg::GenericOp producers ('upstream replaceForWithNewSignature only supports linalg::GenericOp ... vectorize would abort on the untiled one') unless all consumers share one fused node, requires consistent indexing maps when >1 user is in the chosen node, and refuses non-last-axis reduction producers consumed by broadcasts ('will generate memref.alloc inside VF and cannot be outlined', issue 638); FusedNode::canFuseProducer additionally rejects producers used as DPS inits (issue 3687) and pairs wouldBecomeTileLocal with reductionConsumerNeedsFullDomain so a reduction consumer never receives a partially tiled operand unless a legal split-reduction consumer exists.

Pipeline placement: in HFusionRegbasePipelines.cpp hfusionAutoVectorizePipeline, upstream preparation runs canonicalization, FoldExtractInsertPair, SinkOpToConsumerInLoop, the manual-scope vectorize pipeline; when enableSIMDVFFusion(hfusionOptions) — defined as exactly options.enableTritonKernelCompile — VFFusionPass (createVFFusionPass, :414) runs, then FlattenOps (Tidy mode) when runRegBasePasses && enableFlatten (:415-423), canonicalization, FuseTransposeIntoLoad, PreVectorizationFusion (:431), PrepareI1Nx1ForVectorization (:432), canonicalization (:433); then 'if (hfusionOptions.enableAutoVectorizeV2)' sets AutoVectorizeV2Options (enableVFStackLimit forced on when multiple-consumer fusion is on, maxFusedOps from hfusionMaxFusedOpsInAutoVectorizeV2, treeReduce, enableCrossIfFusion) and adds createHFusionAutoVectorizeV2Pass (:450) immediately followed by createOutlineVectorFunctionPass (:451); the else branch adds the legacy createHFusionAutoVectorizePass with maxVectorizeAxes=2 (:453-460); createAutoVectorizeVerifierPass runs after both branches (:462).

Outlining into vector functions: OutlineVectorFunctionPass walks each func's blocks and groups scf::ForOps carrying an 'outlined-loop-target-*' attr — a new VF starts whenever the next labeled loop is not adjacent to the previous one, and 'outlinedLoopWithFill' loops are outlined alone; per group it emits transform::ExtendedLoopOutlineOp producing a function named <func>_outlined_vf_<i> and a call site, then annotates both the function and the call with hivm.vector_function (HIVM_VFAttr 'vector_function') and 'no_inline', plus kFillVFAttrName on fill VFs; duplicateReusedValuesForInnerSCFForOp pre-copies reused static tensors into inner-loop iter args; after outlining it strips the outlined* label attrs. Downstream, hivm::isVF(funcOp)/isVFCall recognize VFs exactly by that hivm.vector_function attr.

Downstream chain and consumer: after the AutoVectorizeV2+OutlineVectorFunction pair, the same pipeline conditionally runs TreeReduceV2 twice (register-tree and legacy-scope variants) when enableTreeReduce && !enableTreeReduceV2 && enableAutoVectorizeV2 && enableRA (:463-479), then HFusionToVector conversion (:480), RemoveMaskFromUnalignedReductionLoop + LowerVectorMask (:481-483), the Inliner to dissolve VFFusion outlines when SIMD VF fusion is on (:484-487), and PullSliceIntoVectorFunction (:489). In the HIVM regbase pipeline, bufferizationPipeline places hfusion::createMergeVecScopePass(mergeLevel=1) before SimplifyVFArgs/tensor-copy-insertion/OneShotBufferize when enableVfMergeLevel==1 (:230-234) and createMergeVecScopePass(mergeLevel=2) immediately after createOneShotBufferizePass when enableVfMergeLevel==2 (:256-260) — the pass that merges the outlined VF scopes.

Test corpus (read, not executed): bishengir/test/Dialect/HFusion/auto-vectorize-v2.mlir runs 'bishengir-opt %s --hfusion-auto-vectorize-v2 --outline-vector-function' and its CHECKs expect @triton_add_outlined_vf_0 with an scf.for containing vector<128xi8>->vector<128xf16> casts and 'arith.addf ... : vector<128xf16>' plus a memref.copy-barrier case split into two outlined functions outlined_vf_0/1; auto-vectorize-v2-cross-group-conflict.mlir documents a circular-group-dependency fixture ({7,10} vs {8,9}); ~20 more fixtures under test/Dialect/HFusion/AutoVectorize/ cover multiple-consumer fusion, cross-if barriers, GM RAW alias, DPS-init fusion, scope cases, and refine-static-loop-carried-tensor.

records.statement: The clone-then-apply-then-commit shape (EV-003) is what makes the pass all-or-nothing per function: every planning mutation (labels, FusedNode::consolidateToTail op moves, transform application) happens on the scratch clone, so a failure anywhere discards the clone and the pipeline input stays valid scalar/tensor IR for the legacy branch or downstream passes. No comment states this motivation; inferred structurally from runAttempt (EV-003) plus the signalPassFailure path (EV-002).

Legacy-fallback drift at this HEAD: legacy AutoVectorize's restrictToFuncNames option documents 'Used by AutoVectorizeV2's legacy fallback to scope it to just the function(s) it failed on' (Passes.td:106-111), but no pipeline call site passes restrictToFuncNames, AutoVectorizeV2's failure path only warns 'AutoVectorizeV2 failed;' (EV-002), commit fa682a1a3 removed the fallback (EV-018), and the test auto-vectorize-v2-fallback-to-v1.mlir that expects 'falling back to legacy HFusionAutoVectorize pass' is marked UNSUPPORTED: bishengir_published and does not match current source. Whether any reachable path still routes a failed function into scoped V1 could not be determined from the read sources; treated as stale option documentation.
